findings.issue: The core data-transformation logic (English name/flavor selection, alternate-form exclusion, move dedup, table ordering) is untested; 'first vs last English flavor entry' or dedup-key regressions would be silent.
findings.suggestion: Extract the pure helpers (englishName, latestFlavorText, shortEffect, toCards, move-table assembly) into plain functions with small fake payloads and unit-test them with vitest — the runner is already set up.

findings.issue: Filter predicate, pagination math, page clamping and the 'reset page / omit defaults' URL update are unguarded.
findings.suggestion: Test the filter/paginate computation directly (it's already nearly pure) and add a routing test for filter→URL round-trips.

findings.issue: Spec-critical sorting semantics — missing values last in both directions, ascending-first flip, aria-sort — have no regression coverage.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the rows() comparator with rows containing null power/accuracy, and a component test asserting aria-sort toggling.

findings.issue: TTL cache and error eviction are untested; a stale-hit or swallowed-error bug would be intermittent and hard to trace in production.
findings.suggestion: Inject a fake fetch/clock and test hit, expiry, failure eviction and 404→ApiNotFoundError mapping.

findings.issue: TransferState handoff and /_data 404→null→NotFound client-navigation path are untested.
findings.suggestion: Test PageData.load against a stubbed loader and TransferState for both the hydration-hit and miss branches.

findings.issue: loadPageData routing (unknown kind, extra segments, malformed escapes → null) has no coverage; a bad decode would 500 instead of 404.
findings.suggestion: Table-test loadPageData with a stubbed apiGet for each segment shape, including '%zz' escapes and trailing slashes.

findings.issue: The suite tests only three helpers, so its existence gives a false sense that unit testing is in place.
findings.suggestion: Use this file as the seed and grow coverage into loaders/home/move-table; the vitest builder is already configured.

summary: The app ships a single, well-written vitest spec covering three trivial formatting helpers — behavioural and noise-free, but pinning ~15 lines out of ~876. All the genuinely risky logic (loader transformations, home filtering/pagination/URL state, move-table sorting, both cache layers, not-found paths) has zero app-owned coverage and relies entirely on the acceptance suite. Infrastructurally the vitest setup is current and correct, so the main ask is to extend it to the pure transformation functions before any data-layer refactor lands.
